searchText: Yes? If you do x MUL y and it overflows it'll just wrap around the other side. It will not throw, stack under/overflow vs. wrapping behaviour of some instructions? Ah, yeah. Maybe they are talking about stack overflow. I'm not sure what stack underflow is though? That's "| | µs | | < δw" (underflow) and "| | µs | | − δw + αw > 1024" (overflow) in Eq (149) of the Yellow Paper. evmone handles those.
